summary.headline: Astrological Rules for Illness
summary.text: Astrological medical rules for treating illness by planetary sympathy, including foods and remedies, critical hours of decumbiture, lunar nodes and phases, eclipses, benefic and malefic configurations, fixed-star risings and settings, zodiacal signs, surgery, twelfth-parts, and violent death.
